mapper.update: update cc_task_config set name=#{name},call_start_time=#{callStartTime},call_end_time=#{callEndTime},close_time=#{closeTime},source_id=#{sourceId},data_source=#{dataSource},transfer_type=#{transferType},transfer_id=#{transferId},transfer_name=#{transferName},display_number=#{displayNumber},call_rounds=#{callRounds},cruise_type=#{cruiseType},concurrency=#{concurrency},number_pool_id=#{numberPoolId},number_pool_name=#{numberPoolName},after_call_duration=#{afterCallDuration},call_timeout=#{callTimeout},status_notify=#{statusNotify},traffic_notify=#{trafficNotify},retry_interval=#{retryInterval},uts=#{uts},version=version+1 where id=#{id} and company_id=#{companyId} and version=#{version} and status=2 and archived=0 and requested_status is null

update cc_task_source set version=version+1 where id=#{id} and company_id=#{companyId} and version=#{version}
update cc_task_field set source_id=null where source_id=#{sourceId} and company_id=#{companyId}
update cc_task_field set source_id=#{sourceId} where id=#{id} and company_id=#{companyId} and (source_id is null or source_id=0 or source_id=#{sourceId})
mapper.select: select count(*) from cc_task_config where company_id=#{companyId} and source_id=#{id}
mapper.delete: delete from cc_task_source where id=#{id} and company_id=#{companyId}
delete from cc_task_field where id=#{id} and company_id=#{companyId} and (source_id is null or source_id=0)
mapper.select: select c.* from cc_task_contact c join cc_task_config t on t.id=c.task_id where t.company_id=#{companyId} and t.id=#{taskId} and t.archived=0 and c.call_status=#{callStatus} and c.current_round=#{round} order by c.id
select p.* from cc_task_pause p join cc_task_config t on t.id=p.task_id where t.company_id=#{companyId} and t.id=#{taskId} and t.archived=0 order by p.id desc
select count(*) from cc_task_field where company_id=#{companyId} and source_id=#{sourceId} and is_phone=1 and status=1

mapper.update: update cc_task_contact c join cc_task_attempt a on a.attempt_id=c.active_attempt_id set c.call_status='retry',c.current_round=greatest(c.current_round-1,0),c.active_attempt_id=null,c.next_attempt_at=#{now} where a.company_id=#{companyId} and a.task_id=#{taskId} and c.task_id=#{taskId} and a.lease_until <= #{now} and a.state='claimed'
update cc_task_attempt set state='expired',uts=#{now} where company_id=#{companyId} and task_id=#{taskId} and lease_until <= #{now} and state='claimed'
mapper.select: select c.* from cc_task_contact c join cc_task_config t on t.id=c.task_id where t.id=#{taskId} and t.company_id=#{companyId} and t.status=1 and t.requested_status is null and t.archived=0 and c.call_status in ('pending','retry') and c.current_round < t.call_rounds and c.next_attempt_at <= #{now} order by c.id limit #{limit} for update skip locked

select count(*) from cc_task_contact c join cc_task_config t on t.id=c.task_id where t.id=#{taskId} and t.company_id=#{companyId} and t.archived=0 and c.call_status in ('dialing','ringing','answered')
select count(*) from cc_task_attempt where company_id=#{companyId} and task_id=#{taskId} and state='claimed'

select count(*) from cc_task_attempt where company_id=#{companyId} and task_id=#{taskId} and call_id=#{callId}

mapper.update: update cc_task_attempt set lease_until=#{leaseUntil},uts=#{now} where attempt_id=#{attemptId} and company_id=#{companyId} and task_id=#{taskId} and lease_token=#{leaseToken} and state='claimed' and lease_until > #{now}

update cc_task_attempt set call_id=#{callId},state='completed',result=#{result},uts=#{uts} where attempt_id=#{attemptId} and company_id=#{companyId} and task_id=#{taskId} and contact_id=#{contactId} and request_id=#{requestId} and lease_token=#{leaseToken} and state='claimed' and lease_until > #{uts}

update cc_task_contact set call_time=#{callTime},answer_time=#{answerTime},bridge_time=#{bridgeTime},call_status=#{callStatus},call_result=#{callResult},agent_code=#{agentCode},active_attempt_id=null,next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt} where id=#{id} and task_id=#{taskId} and active_attempt_id=#{activeAttemptId}

update cc_task_config set total_count=(select count(*) from cc_task_contact where task_id=#{id}),list_total=(select count(*) from cc_task_contact where task_id=#{id}),dialed_count=(select count(*) from cc_task_attempt where task_id=#{id} and call_id is not null),answered_count=(select count(*) from cc_task_contact where task_id=#{id} and call_result='answered' and call_status='completed'),completed_count=(select count(*) from cc_task_contact where task_id=#{id} and call_status='completed'),uts=#{now} where id=#{id} and company_id=#{companyId}
